name: create_user
description: Register a new user with an email and wallet address. Performs ZK human verification mock.

walletAddress.description: User's primary wallet address (optional, will be generated if not provided)

zkProofData.description: Mock ZK proof data for human verification

name: create_agent
description: Create a new AI agent (lender or borrower) for a ZK-verified user.

userId.description: The ID of the registered user

ensName.description: Target ENS name for the agent (must be valid ENS)

name: post_lend_offer
description: Lender agent posts an offer to the lending marketplace.

name: request_borrow
description: Borrower agent requests a loan from the marketplace.

name: get_borrow_quote
description: Get a quote for a potential loan, including required collateral and interest.

name: repay_loan
description: Repay an active loan and report profit generated.

name: get_agent_reputation
description: Get the current reputation score and loan limits for an agent.

name: fetch_open_offers
description: Fetch all open lend offers from the marketplace, optionally filtered by minimum reputation and maximum amount.

minRep.description: Minimum reputation required for the offer

maxAmount.description: Maximum USDC amount allowed for the offer

name: search_token
description: Search for tokens across all supported blockchains by symbol or contract address. Returns matching tokens with their chain, address, and current USD price.

symbol_or_address.description: Token ticker symbol (e.g. 'USDC') or contract address.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 5).

name: get_token_price
description: Get the real-time USD price for a specific token on a given chain.

name: get_balances
description: Get all token balances for a wallet address across supported chains.

name: get_portfolio
description: Retrieve a comprehensive portfolio analysis for a wallet, including token balances, DeFi positions, staking positions, and total USD value.

name: analyze_wallet
description: Perform a deep behavioral and risk analysis of a wallet, including trading patterns, risk score, and on-chain activity summary.

name: get_pnl_report
description: Get a profit-and-loss (PnL) report for a wallet over a chosen time period, including realized and unrealized gains/losses.

name: get_swap_quote
description: Fetch an optimal swap quote including estimated output amount, price impact, gas estimate, and routing path — without executing any transaction.

from_amount.description: Amount of source token to swap (as a string, e.g. '100').

to_chain.description: Destination chain (can be the same as from_chain).

wallet_address.description: Wallet address used to calculate approvals / gas.

slippage.description: Maximum acceptable slippage in percent (e.g. 2.0 for 2%).

name: execute_swap
description: Execute a real token swap on-chain via the Elsa pipeline system. Returns a pipeline_id that must be monitored with get_transaction_status. Set dry_run=true to simulate without sending a real transaction.

dry_run.description: If true, simulate only; no real transaction.

name: create_limit_order
description: Create a limit order via CoW Protocol. The order executes automatically when the market price reaches limit_price. Returns a pipeline_id for signing and monitoring.

limit_price.description: Minimum price to accept for the swap (e.g. '0.0003' means sell when 1 unit of from_token = 0.0003 to_token).

name: get_limit_orders
description: Fetch all active and historical limit orders for a wallet.

wallet_address.description: Wallet address whose orders to fetch.

name: cancel_limit_order
description: Cancel a pending limit order. Returns a pipeline_id for the cancellation transaction that must be signed.

order_id.description: Order ID to cancel (0x… hash from get_limit_orders).

wallet_address.description: Wallet address that owns the order.

name: get_stake_balances
description: View all active staking positions for a wallet across protocols (Lido, Rocket Pool, etc.) with current APY and staked amounts.

wallet_address.description: Wallet address to query staking positions for.

name: get_yield_suggestions
description: Discover the best yield / farming opportunities tailored to a wallet's current holdings. Returns suggested protocols with estimated APY.

wallet_address.description: Wallet address whose holdings are used to generate suggestions.

name: check_airdrop
description: Check whether a wallet is eligible for a specific ELSA airdrop tranche and, if so, how many tokens it can claim.

chain.description: Chain where the airdrop is distributed (e.g. 'base').

eoa_address.description: Wallet address to check eligibility for.

name: claim_airdrop
description: Create a pipeline to claim ELSA airdrop tokens for a specific tranche. Returns a pipeline_id — monitor with get_transaction_status and sign the transaction when it reaches 'sign_pending' status.

chain.description: Chain where the airdrop is distributed (e.g. 'base').

eoa_address.description: Wallet address that will receive the tokens.

dry_run.description: Preview the claim pipeline without executing.

name: get_transaction_history
description: Retrieve on-chain transaction history for a wallet address.

wallet_address.description: Wallet address to fetch history for.

limit.description: Maximum number of transactions to return (default 10).

name: get_transaction_status
description: Monitor the status of an Elsa pipeline and its tasks. Returns the current status ('pending', 'sign_pending', 'success', 'failed') and, when ready to sign, the tx_data payload for wallet signing.

pipeline_id.description: Pipeline ID returned by execute_swap, claim_airdrop, etc.

name: submit_transaction_hash
description: After the user signs a transaction returned by get_transaction_status, submit the resulting transaction hash back to the pipeline so the next task can proceed.

tx_hash.description: Signed transaction hash (0x…) returned by the RPC.

status.description: 'submitted' if the tx was broadcast; 'rejected' if the user declined.

error.description: Error message — required only when status is 'rejected'.

name: get_gas_prices
description: Fetch current gas prices (in gwei) for a specific blockchain network.

name: health_check
description: Check if the Elsa X402 API server is healthy. Returns server version and X402 payment information.
